text_block_list.text: On our way back from shopping for training gear with Gran Alegria.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
why don't we try that?!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, the lottery raffle! Because, you know,
I really, really want to go on a hot springs trip!”

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"We get to soak in hot springs AND earn airline miles!
Isn't that killing two birds with one stone?!"
Gran Alegria kept chatting away as if winning was a foregone conclusion. Even so—
choice_data_list: ...You know the hot springs trip is the grand prize, right?
...You know the hot springs trip is the grand prize, right?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
? Yes!
I'll guess it right, just watch me!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Especially today! I made my signature morning salad, caught the Diet broadcast, and did all sorts of other things!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: My mile combo keeps stacking up, so I'm in top form! I'm definitely gonna nail this~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
So can I use
the lottery tickets now?

Come to think of it, I had received a ticket while shopping.
I take it out and hand it to her.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Whew!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
My Rule!
"Whistle to pump myself up when it's crunch time!"
Here I go!
Gran Alegria spun the lottery wheel handle with gusto!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Waaay! Ahaha, yay!
I'm 100 miles of happy~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ahem, I did it!
I guessed it right, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Now we can go on that "Hot Springs Trip"!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the inn is set,
but everything else is completely open, huh~

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Since I've got the chance, maybe I'll make this the ultimate mile trip,
entirely produced by me!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you'd better look forward to it~♪
...Listening to her speak, I realize something. Apparently, she intends to come along with me.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you want me? Well, if you insist—
Are you sure about me? Well, since we're here—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Since we have this opportunity, you know.
Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I want to use this 'special opportunity'
to show my gratitude to you!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Please? Is that a no?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but of course, if you're not in the mood,
Trainer-san, that's totally fine!
choice_data_list: N-No way, I'd love to come!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Really!?
Thank goodness, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~. Hot springs, hot springs, hot springs trip~♪
Guess I'll eat a date fruit~!

And so, a promise to go on a hot spring trip
was made with Gran Alegria.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Aww, so close!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Still, the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"
looks delicious, so that's fine too~♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, while we're at it, let's make a salad or something
and have a mini party just the two of us!

And so, we suddenly ended up
cooking dinner in the Trainer's Room!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Chop-chop-chop-chop...!
Mmh, all done!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Look at this!
A heart-shaped caaarrot!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, isn't it~!
I'll take a picture later!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Umm, next is... Trainer, do we have any paprika powder?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
...How much of this do we need?
choice_data_list: ...Wouldn't make much difference even without it, would it?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Never mind then~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yay, thank you so much!
Well then, next up isâ
And so, the two of us merrily made a salad... preparing for our little party!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Aw man, 2nd prize!
Well, don't sweat it, me!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Still, to receive so much!
I'm so happy~!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Since we got this much... Oh, I know!
I just had a great idea!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Carrot Stall Gran is here!
I brought some refreshments~!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
A food stall—
Oh, look at all those roasted carrots!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ehe! I got so many of them, I wanted to share some with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Our flavors are Salt, Butter, and Sugar!
And for doneness, we have Rare, Medium, and Well-done—
3 styles to choose from!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"E-Even how to cook it!?
Getting all this ready must've been really tough, right...?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Not at all!
I was having so much fun that it was over before I knew it~!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, don't be shy, grab as much as you want!
Eat it while it's hot!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Um, in that case... I'll have one medium, salted, please.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Coming right up~!
One salt, order up!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Then I'll take one Rare Sugar!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, then...
Well-done with butter, please.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Right away!
Coming right up~!
The massive pile of carrots was transformed into the Grand Carrot Stall, bustling with life in a corner of the grounds.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Oops! It's third prize!
Too baaaad!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mm, but we got a carrot out of it, right?!
Total bargain, total bargain♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
With this, maybe I should... Oh, I know!
I'll make up some house rules for carrots!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Speaking of things that get you hyped when eating carrots...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Hmm, "Eat it skin and all!" ...Is that not quite it?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"First, take a big raw bite!"
............

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I feel like there's something even better out there!
Let's go look for it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Come to me~, my rules!

And so, to discover her own personal carrot rules,
the two of us took a stroll through the shopping district for a while.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Gaaasp! What a shocker!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—Aha! Just kidding!
Pocket tissues, huh~ A bit of a bummer!
choice_data_list: I'm sure you'll pull the grand prize next time!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course! I'm sure you'll pull it easily next time!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me! Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"When I'm in a slump, I look toward my hometown."
It's my personal rule! Just in case, you know...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Phew...
Despite what she said... Gran Alegria looked just a little disappointed.
